# gh-delta flags

<!-- Generated by tools/skill/generate-flags.mjs; do not edit by hand. -->

This reference is generated from `lib/help.mjs`. Run `npm run build:skill` after help changes.

## gh-delta

`gh-delta [--repo <owner/name>] [--monitor-id <id>] [--state-file <path> | --state-dir <dir>] [--entities pr,issue] [--format json|text|compact|ndjson] [--summary-line] [--detail] [--summaries] [--enrich review,comments,threads,body,thread-replies] [--only-classes <classes>] [--ignore-classes <classes>] [--ignore-authors <logins>] [--settled] [--baseline-emit-state] [--log] [--outpost-url <url>] [--outpost-secret <ENV_VARIABLE_NAME>] [--outpost-timeout-ms <ms>] [--outpost-max-posts <n>] [--gh-timeout-ms <ms>] [--rate-limit-floor <n>] [--no-registry] [--lock-stale-ms <duration>]`

| Flag                                                     | Default  | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--repo <owner/name[,owner/name]>`                       |          | GitHub repository in owner/name form. May be comma-separated or repeated; two or more explicit repositories run serially and return one aggregate report. Optional when selecting one repo: when omitted, derived from the current directory’s git remote (origin, then upstream; github.com only) with a `gh repo view` fallback for GitHub Enterprise and SSH-config host aliases. When origin and upstream differ, origin is used and a warning names the other; pass --repo to choose explicitly.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--monitor-id <id>`                                      |          | Stable monitor identity used in reports, event IDs, and derived snapshot paths. Optional: defaults to host- plus a hash of hostname and git worktree (or cwd outside git). GH_DELTA_MONITOR_ID supplies an environment default; --monitor-id wins. Pass an explicit id for durable automation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `--state-file <path>`                                    |          | Explicit snapshot JSON path. Mutually exclusive with --state-dir. Optional: without either flag, a monitor-scoped file under <system temp dir>/gh-delta-<user>/ is used (per-user 0700, ephemeral — reboots or tmp cleanup silently re-seed the baseline).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--state-dir <dir>`                                      |          | Directory for a derived snapshot path scoped by repo, monitor id, and selected entities. Mutually exclusive with --state-file. Optional: see --state-file for the temp-dir default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--watch-dir <path>`                                     |          | Local watch-list directory. When --entities includes pr and the list has 0-10 PR-only entries, automatically makes one targeted GraphQL request (zero for empty) and uses a separate watch snapshot; issue entries, >10 entries, or --entities issue retain broad fetching. Mutually exclusive with --number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--number <numbers>`                                     |          | Ephemeral comma-separated positive-number post-fetch selector.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `--entities <pr,issue>`                                  | pr,issue | Comma-separated entity list: pr, issue, or pr,issue.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--format <json\|text\|compact\|ndjson>`                 | json     | Output format: legacy json/text, or agent-oriented compact JSON / line-oriented NDJSON.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--summary-line`                                         |          | Add a human-readable summaryLine field to each JSON delta.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--detail`                                               |          | Add structured details per delta, plus summaryLine and the backward-compatible line alias.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--summaries`                                            |          | Add a normalized semantic delta.summary to PR deltas (ciRollup, reviewDecision, mergeable, mergeStateStatus, state, isDraft, unresolvedReviewThreads, headSha) derived from the same observation as the opaque fingerprints, so a consumer reads the semantic state without a second GitHub fetch. Additive and off by default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--enrich <review,comments,threads,body,thread-replies>` |          | After a successful snapshot write only, fetch bodies for matching emitted deltas: review-changed (review), new-comments (comments), unresolved-threads-added (threads), new/first-seen/reopened/baseline-state (body -- one nodes() call per delta for the item's own body, attached as enrichment.body = { body, mentions }; never called for a plain updated), or review-comments-added (thread-replies -- one aliased per-thread GraphQL call per delta, each thread's own comments(last: N) where N is that thread's reply-count increment). Off by default; failures are warnings and never change detection state. Exception: when --ignore-authors and --enrich thread-replies are both set, thread-replies is additionally fetched once, pre-publish, scoped to filtering only (never populates delta.enrichment before publication) -- the one case where opt-in enrichment quota is spent before the snapshot/log write; see --ignore-authors.                                              |
| `--only-classes <classes>`                               |          | Attention filter: keep a delta when it carries at least one named class. Unknown classes are config errors. Apply before --ignore-classes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--ignore-classes <classes>`                             |          | Attention filter: remove named classes from each delta, dropping a delta left with no classes. Unknown classes are config errors; this is the final class veto.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--ignore-authors <logins>`                              |          | Attention filter: suppress new-comments when every newly inferred bounded conversation comment has a listed author, suppress review-changed when every newly inferred review author is listed, and suppress review-comments-added when every reply across its incremented threads has a listed author. Fails open silently (as before) whenever conversation or review lacks the identity it needs to check: conversation, if the five-row window is incomplete or an author/id is missing; reviews, if a changed review lacks an attributable row. Thread replies are the one source that warns explicitly when it cannot verify -- either because --enrich thread-replies is not also set, or because a brand-new thread only partly (or not at all) explains the observed reviewComments rise -- unless the double opt-in supplies full author coverage, via one pre-publish, filter-scoped thread-replies call: the sole exception to opt-in enrichment quota being spent only after publication. |
| `--settled`                                              |          | Attention filter: drop a delta whose summary has ciRollup pending or mergeable unknown. Implies --summaries; ciRollup none is settled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--baseline-emit-state`                                  |          | On the run that seeds a baseline, also emit one synthetic baseline-state delta per tracked OPEN item (from: null, to: the observed fingerprint) so pre-existing trouble (already conflicting, already CI-blocked) is visible instead of silent until the next change. Off by default; the run then exits 10 with baseline: true and a non-empty deltas array. Ids are content-addressed and stable across re-baselining. Do NOT treat baseline-state as newly created.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--log`                                                  |          | Append each emitted post-filter delta to its monitor-scoped durable NDJSON log and fsync it before publishing the snapshot. Off by default; without it no log is opened.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `--outpost-url <url>`                                    |          | Send one fire-and-forget HTTP POST per delta when exit code is 10.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--outpost-secret <ENV_VARIABLE_NAME>`                   |          | Read the outpost HMAC secret from this environment variable and sign each POST body. Requires --outpost-url; the argument is a variable name, never the secret value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--outpost-timeout-ms <ms>`                              | 4000     | Timeout per outpost HTTP POST in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `--outpost-max-posts <n>`                                |          | Cap outpost POST count per run; omit for unlimited.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--gh-timeout-ms <ms>`                                   | 60000    | Timeout for each GitHub API subprocess call in milliseconds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--rate-limit-floor <n>`                                 |          | Before fetching an observation, require at least n GraphQL rate-limit points. Off by default; a lower remaining quota exits transiently with resetAt and leaves the snapshot unchanged.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--no-registry`                                          |          | Skip the best-effort run-registry breadcrumb this run would otherwise leave for gh-delta list. Equivalent to setting GH_DELTA_NO_REGISTRY=1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--lock-stale-ms <duration>`                             | 10m      | Ceiling age for an unreadable/corrupt state-file lock (a kill mid-write can truncate it) before it is presumed abandoned and stolen, with a warning. Does not apply to a readable lock with a future expiresAt -- that one is only stolen once expired. Deleting a stale .lock file by hand is always safe.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--stale-after <duration>`                               |          | Emit one stale delta per UTC day of inactivity after this shared-duration threshold.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--help`                                                 |          | Show human-readable help.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--help-json`                                            |          | Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--version`                                              |          | Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## gh-delta list

`gh-delta list [--state-dir <dir>] [--since <duration>] [--format json|text]`

| Flag                    | Default | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--state-dir <dir>`     |         | Narrow the inventory to a scan of this directory only, skipping the run registry. Optional: without it, the registry plus the per-user temp default location are inventoried. |
| `--since <duration>`    |         | Only list monitors whose last run is within this window (e.g. 90s, 15m, 24h, 7d). Optional: without it, every monitor snapshot is listed.                                     |
| `--format <json\|text>` | json    | Output format: json for programs, text for operators and scheduled logs.                                                                                                      |
| `--help`                |         | Show human-readable help.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `--help-json`           |         | Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.                                                                                                                            |
| `--version`             |         | Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.                                                                                                                         |

## gh-delta read

`gh-delta read --cursor <path> [--only-classes <classes>] [--number <positive integer>] [--advance] [--format json|text]`

| Flag                          | Default | Meaning                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--cursor <path>`             |         | Existing cursor JSON file bound to one absolute delta log path.                                                                                       |
| `--only-classes <classes>`    |         | Keep a record when its delta has at least one named class.                                                                                            |
| `--number <positive integer>` |         | Keep only deltas for this GitHub issue or pull-request number; this is not a result limit.                                                            |
| `--advance`                   |         | Serialize this cursor, then atomically store the complete log tail scanned; rejected records are also advanced past. A concurrent mutator exits busy. |
| `--format <json\|text>`       | json    | Output format: json for programs, text for operators and scheduled logs.                                                                              |
| `--help`                      |         | Show human-readable help.                                                                                                                             |
| `--help-json`                 |         | Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.                                                                                                    |
| `--version`                   |         | Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.                                                                                                 |

## gh-delta wait

`gh-delta wait --timeout <duration> [--until <classes>] [--until-summary <field=value[,value...]>] [--interval <duration>] [--heartbeat-file <path>] [--progress] [--from-log --cursor <path>] [detector options]`

| Flag                                                     | Default  | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--timeout <duration>`                                   |          | Maximum total wait; uses the shared positive duration grammar.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `--until <classes>`                                      |          | Comma-separated delta classes that satisfy a future emitted delta.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--until-summary <field=value[,value...]>`               |          | Current PR summary condition; comma-separated values are alternatives and are evaluated on the first iteration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--interval <duration>`                                  | 60s      | Initial delay between iterations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `--max-interval <duration>`                              |          | Optional cap for backoff delays.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--backoff <positive number>`                            | 1        | Multiply the next delay after an unmatched iteration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--settle <duration>`                                    |          | Delay final delivery after a matching future delta.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--heartbeat-file <path>`                                |          | Runtime heartbeat file; defaults to <stateFile>.hb.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--progress`                                             |          | Write one NDJSON tick record to stderr per completed iteration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--from-log`                                             |          | Consume the local durable delta log through --cursor; never contacts GitHub.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--cursor <path>`                                        |          | Required cursor binding when --from-log is selected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--format <json\|text>`                                  | json     | Output format: json for programs, text for operators and scheduled logs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `--help`                                                 |          | Show human-readable help.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--help-json`                                            |          | Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--version`                                              |          | Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## gh-delta cursor set

`gh-delta cursor set <cursor-path> <seq> [--log-file <path>] [--format json|text]`

| Flag                    | Default | Meaning                                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--log-file <path>`     |         | Absolute or relative log path; normalized to absolute. Required only to initialize a missing cursor. |
| `--format <json\|text>` | json    | Output format: json for programs, text for operators and scheduled logs.                             |
| `--help`                |         | Show human-readable help.                                                                            |
| `--help-json`           |         | Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.                                                   |
| `--version`             |         | Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.                                                |

## gh-delta log compact

`gh-delta log compact --repo <owner/name> --monitor-id <id> (--state-file <path>|--state-dir <dir>) --keep <duration|positive-count> [--entities pr,issue] [--format json|text]`

| Flag                                | Default  | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--repo <owner/name>`               |          | GitHub repository in owner/name form for the producer identity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--monitor-id <id>`                 |          | Stable monitor identity used in reports, event IDs, and derived snapshot paths. Optional: defaults to host- plus a hash of hostname and git worktree (or cwd outside git). GH_DELTA_MONITOR_ID supplies an environment default; --monitor-id wins. Pass an explicit id for durable automation. |
| `--entities <pr,issue>`             | pr,issue | Comma-separated entity list: pr, issue, or pr,issue.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--state-file <path>`               |          | Explicit snapshot JSON path. Mutually exclusive with --state-dir. Optional: without either flag, a monitor-scoped file under <system temp dir>/gh-delta-<user>/ is used (per-user 0700, ephemeral — reboots or tmp cleanup silently re-seed the baseline).                                     |
| `--state-dir <dir>`                 |          | Directory for a derived snapshot path scoped by repo, monitor id, and selected entities. Mutually exclusive with --state-file. Optional: see --state-file for the temp-dir default.                                                                                                            |
| `--keep <duration\|positive-count>` |          | Keep newest count records or records detected in the duration window.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `--format <json\|text>`             | json     | Output format: json for programs, text for operators and scheduled logs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## gh-delta reset

`gh-delta reset --repo <owner/name> --monitor-id <id> (--state-file <path>|--state-dir <dir>) --yes [--entities pr,issue] [--format json|text]`

| Flag                    | Default  | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--repo <owner/name>`   |          | GitHub repository in owner/name form for the producer identity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--monitor-id <id>`     |          | Stable monitor identity used in reports, event IDs, and derived snapshot paths. Optional: defaults to host- plus a hash of hostname and git worktree (or cwd outside git). GH_DELTA_MONITOR_ID supplies an environment default; --monitor-id wins. Pass an explicit id for durable automation. |
| `--entities <pr,issue>` | pr,issue | Comma-separated entity list: pr, issue, or pr,issue.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--state-file <path>`   |          | Explicit snapshot JSON path. Mutually exclusive with --state-dir. Optional: without either flag, a monitor-scoped file under <system temp dir>/gh-delta-<user>/ is used (per-user 0700, ephemeral — reboots or tmp cleanup silently re-seed the baseline).                                     |
| `--state-dir <dir>`     |          | Directory for a derived snapshot path scoped by repo, monitor id, and selected entities. Mutually exclusive with --state-file. Optional: see --state-file for the temp-dir default.                                                                                                            |
| `--yes`                 |          | Confirm the deletion. Without it, reset is refused before locking anything.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--format <json\|text>` | json     | Output format: json for programs, text for operators and scheduled logs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `--help`                |          | Show human-readable help.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--help-json`           |          | Print this machine-readable help document as JSON.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `--version`             |          | Print version, distribution channel, and release URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
